entries.title: access_profiles
entries.summary: Company-customized access profile: a named set of delegable business capabilities that grants can carry instead of a standard role.

entries.title: backchannel_logout_replays
entries.summary: Identifiers of accepted provider logout tokens, kept to reject a replayed token.

entries.title: branches
entries.summary: Branch of a company: a location with its own business time zone, assigned members and, later, devices.

entries.title: companies
entries.summary: Customer company: the tenant that owns branches, memberships, content, devices and publications.

entries.title: company_invitation_branches
entries.summary: Explicit branches of a branch-scoped invitation; all must still be active when it is accepted.

entries.title: company_invitations
entries.summary: An invitation for a recipient address to join a company with one grant; only the person signed in with that verified address can accept it.

entries.title: company_responsibilities
entries.summary: The company's designated responsible administrator, who approves additional administrators (P10).

entries.title: device_audit_events
entries.summary: Append-only device lifecycle audit: pairing, renaming, rotation, moves, unlinking, erasure confirmation and recorded resets.

entries.title: device_claim_failures
entries.summary: Counter rows for failed pairing-code claims, which bound guessing per person and per company.

entries.title: device_enrollments
entries.summary: A screen's request to be paired: the hash of the credential the player generated, the HMAC of the short code it shows and its report. Platform-scoped until a member claims the code.

entries.title: devices
entries.summary: A paired screen: its identity in one company and branch, configuration, credential hash and unlink/erasure state.

entries.title: human_sessions
entries.summary: Server-managed browser session: an opaque cookie credential's hash, its bounds and assurance, and the sealed provider tokens obtained for it.

entries.title: media_assets
entries.summary: A media item of a company: one uploaded image or video, its owning scope (the company or one branch), name and tags, inspected facts and the objects derived from it.

entries.title: media_audit_events
entries.summary: Append-only record of a media item's lifecycle changes, with the acting member or none for the processor and maintenance.

entries.title: media_objects
entries.summary: One stored file of a company on the media volume, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes: an original upload, a display rendition or a thumbnail. Identical bytes are stored once per company and never shared across companies.

entries.title: membership_grant_branches
entries.summary: Explicit branches covered by a BRANCHES-scoped grant; new branches never join silently.

entries.title: membership_grants
entries.summary: A standard role or a company-customized access profile granted to a membership over the whole company or explicit branches; grants combine additively.

entries.title: memberships
entries.summary: A principal's membership in one company; access comes only from its unexpired grants.

entries.title: oidc_login_attempts
entries.summary: Single-use binding between a browser login-attempt cookie and the OIDC state, nonce and PKCE verifier of one authorization request.

entries.title: organization_audit_event_branches
entries.summary: Branches an organization audit event concerns; branch managers read only events whose branches all lie within their own branches.

entries.title: organization_audit_events
entries.summary: Append-only attributable record of company, branch, membership and grant changes, written in the same transaction as each change.

entries.title: outbound_emails
entries.summary: Transactional outbox of email messages: a producer records the intent in its own transaction and the dispatcher delivers it through the SMTP relay at least once.

entries.title: playlist_items
entries.summary: One position of a playlist: the media item it plays and, for an image, how long.

entries.title: playlists
entries.summary: An ordered, looping list of media items owned by a company or one branch, with its transition. Several programs may schedule the same playlist.

entries.title: principals
entries.summary: Provider-independent application principal for one human identity at one issuer; its UUID is the stable identity referenced by memberships, ownership and audit.

entries.title: program_outputs
entries.summary: One output of a program (the full screen now; layout areas later) with its optional default playlist.

entries.title: programming_audit_events
entries.summary: Append-only record of programming changes and assignments, with the acting member and the branches each change concerns.

entries.title: programming_device_settings
entries.summary: A screen's programming source: its group, if any, and whether individual programming is selected.

entries.title: programming_group_branches
entries.summary: The explicit branch span of a group that does not cover the whole company.

entries.title: programming_groups
entries.summary: A company-owned group of screens that share one program, spanning the whole company or a fixed set of branches.

entries.title: programs
entries.summary: The draft programming of one source: exactly one group or one screen.

entries.title: responsibility_transfers
entries.summary: A responsible administrator's proposal to hand company responsibility to another active administrator; it takes effect only when that successor accepts.

entries.title: schedule_rules
entries.summary: A recurring local-time window that assigns a playlist to one output of a program. Rules store local values only; zones apply per screen when evaluating.

entries.title: ErrorNotice
entries.summary: Displays a public API failure message and an optional reload action.
